normalization.title: The Funnel Is Not the Frontier

source.dateNote: Source metadata reported in original public edition; no independent source-date revalidation.

normalization.overview: DevLogic narrates Karpathy's AI-use funnel and its proposed filters of ambition, jagged capability and access. It contrasts casual use with technical work and private laboratory accounts.
normalization.whyItMatters: Useful for interpreting conflicting AI anecdotes. Watch the short framing; skip it if you need a measured census or access to confidential lab results.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Separate competence, access and verified outcomes. Compare bounded tasks and disclose interventions rather than ranking people with unmeasured population estimates.
normalization.falsification: Reconsider the recommendation if a controlled comparison on the stated task shows no benefit, or exposes permission failures, omitted evidence or greater cost than the ordinary workflow. See the original article for its specific proposed controls.
normalization.freshness: Evidence references checked 2026-10-18T14:33:10Z; historical ledger entries remain unverified unless individually mapped below. Mutable product and incident claims can become stale.
